repository: Use the included local shared-app.bundle; remote GitHub access is not required
browser_assertions: Title and h1 contain the unique marker
Fill the name field with the unique marker and click Greet
resume_assertions: Read existing browser/RAM/disk state before any navigation, reload, or second edit. Then use a second marker for the resumed workload.
write_prefix_rule: Use a unique n100-<run>/<case>/<trial>/ subdirectory in the assigned provider prefix. Delete only those generated keys.
network_probe_instructions: Use the controlled S3 object for ordinary HTTPS workload probes. Separately, check the provider's IPv6 docs and make one forced AF_INET6 HTTPS request from one sandbox per provider (e.g. curl --ipv6); record the docs link, command, connected IPv6 address and response/error. Reuse existing conclusive evidence. Do not repeat IPv6 probes in each N=100 trial. Never log the signed query string.
credential_instructions: Fetch current provider credentials from the existing evaluation config. Export shared AWS credentials from the verified profile into private process-local files only; do not publish them or put control-plane keys in the guest. Refresh or report expiry before dispatch; do not classify expired credentials as provider networking failures.
test_scope: Only clone, edit, install/start, browser, mounted-S3 and measurement work. Do not deploy, run a Supabase migration, push code, change plans, or stop unrelated resources.
